title: Anonymous business (Conversion Fanatics logo study): customer logos (loss)
industry: Business with corporate and institutional customers

change.control: Landing page shows the existing selection of customer logos.

notes: Almost 90% is approximate; numeric value preserves the rounded prose rather than using figure alt-text 89.9%. Conversion event and company business model not disclosed; Lead Gen is tentative based on a campaign landing page, not evidence of a specific product.
